summary: FestyVille v2 (Pre-Planning + 7-day cycle + lineup booking) tested end-to-end. All 17 backend tests pass (catalog, artists, set_genre, book/unbook, advance_day, simulate w/ genre_bonus+lineup_boost+auto-reset, start_cycle). All 18 frontend flow checks pass: HUD day-chip ('C1 · Day 1/7') and genre-chip ('Pick genre'), planning banner, navigation to /planning, 5 genre chips, empty artist list until genre picked, EDM filter shows 3 artists, booking flips row to 'BOOKED ✓', end-day alert with Daily News, transition to planning-go-festival on day 7, festival-day-banner on main.

issues: Deprecation console warnings: 'shadow*' props (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' props (use textShadow), and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Optional: replace shadow*/textShadow* React Native Web style props with boxShadow/textShadow to silence console warnings.

Optional minor bug in /app/frontend/app/planning.tsx toggleArtist catch: references `inMessage(state.lineup.includes(a.id))` after the await — state is the pre-call snapshot so it computes the right pre-call boolean, so behavior is correct, but the code reads confusingly. Consider capturing `const wasBooked = state.lineup.includes(a.id)` before the await.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~560 lines; still manageable but approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting catalog/artists constants and route groups (planning vs build vs simulate) into separate modules in a future iteration.
simulate() resets cycle/day/genre/lineup atomically with the festival run — confirmed via test: post-simulate GET state shows cycle=2, day=1, genre=null, lineup=[].
advance_day enforces 'genre required on day 1' and 'already on festival day on day 7' as specified.
All endpoints exclude MongoDB _id via projection in get_or_create_state and leaderboard query — verified.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates its own TEST_p_* player; no shared seed data required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL is https://festival-builder-2.preview.emergentagent.com (from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Pytest run: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_festyville_v2.py -v`. Frontend bundle takes ~10-15s to load on first hit; use timeout >=20s for the first wait_for_selector. window.alert is overridden in tests via add_init_script to capture Daily News alerts. testIDs verified: hud-day-chip, hud-genre-chip, planning-banner, festival-day-banner, genre-chip-{id}, artist-row-{id}, planning-end-day, planning-go-festival.
